title: Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City rescues people and pets during Hurricane Florence Response
description: Chief Petty Officer Brad Fitzpatrick, the aviation survival technician shop supervisor at Air Station Atlantic City, works to rescue two people and six dogs from a flooded home in North Carolina after Hurricane Florence swept though the area, Sept. 19, 2018. Fitzpatrick worked with other aircrews through out the day in extreme conditions, encountering submerged barbed wire fences, floating fire-ant beds, and chest-deep water to save lives. U.S. Coast Guard video by Chief Petty Officer Brad Fitzpatrick
